_description: Empirical base rates for prediction market categories. Used to anchor LLM probability estimates with real historical data instead of hallucinated reference classes. Focus on politics, economics, and policy — markets where the bot has genuine edge.

patterns.reference_class: US government shutdowns since 1976: 22 funding gaps, ~35% lasted >7 days
When shutdown deadlines approach, Congress passes a CR ~75% of the time
FOMC meetings 2000-2024: rate cuts occurred at ~42% of meetings during easing cycles
FOMC meetings 2000-2024: rate hikes occurred at ~38% of meetings during tightening cycles
FOMC meetings 2000-2024: rates held steady at ~55% of all meetings
When Fed moves, 25bps is standard (~70%); 50bps occurs ~25% of moves; 75bps is rare (~5%)
US recessions since 1945: ~15% of any given year is in recession (avg recession lasts 10 months)
Announced executive orders: ~70% are signed within the stated timeframe
Threatened tariffs 2017-2024: ~60% were implemented as announced
Announced tariffs are delayed or exempted ~40% of the time
Announced sanctions are implemented ~65% of the time within the stated window
Presidential impeachment: 3 impeachments in 46 presidencies (~7%); 0 convictions
SCOTUS cert grants: ~65% of cases are decided in the direction of the petitioner
SCOTUS overturns its own precedent in <5% of cases heard
Cabinet nominations: ~85% of nominees are confirmed by the Senate
Bills that reach a floor vote pass ~45% of the time (many fail on party-line votes)
Bills with bipartisan co-sponsors pass at ~65% rate
Presidential vetoes: ~25% of vetoed bills are overridden by Congress
Veto overrides are rare: only ~7% of regular vetoes have been overridden historically
Monthly CPI surprises: ~50% come in above consensus, ~50% below
Core CPI (ex food/energy) surprises: ~50% above, ~50% below consensus
Monthly jobs reports: ~50% beat consensus, ~50% miss
Weekly jobless claims: ~50% come in above forecast, ~50% below
Quarterly GDP: ~55% of quarters show growth above prior quarter
Monthly PPI surprises: ~50% above consensus, ~50% below
Monthly retail sales: ~50% beat consensus, ~50% miss
Housing data surprises: roughly evenly split vs consensus
Presidential pardons: ~40% of publicly discussed potential pardons are granted
patterns.source: DOJ Office of the Pardon Attorney

patterns.reference_class: Announced ceasefires in active conflicts: ~20% hold for >30 days
Publicly discussed hostage deals materialize ~30% of the time
SpaceX launch success rate: ~98% for Falcon 9, ~50% for Starship test flights
Debt ceiling crises: Congress has raised/suspended the ceiling 100% of the time since 1960
The US has never defaulted on its debt obligations
US incumbent re-election: ~70% of incumbents win their race
Candidates leading in polls 30 days out win ~75% of the time
Presidential approval rarely moves >3 points in a month; 50/50 up vs down
The party holding the seat wins special elections ~55% of the time
Frontrunners in polls 30 days before primary win ~80% of the time
Publicly speculated resignations materialize ~15% of the time
Publicly speculated firings/dismissals occur ~25% of the time
When grand jury investigations are public knowledge, indictments follow ~30% of the time within 90 days
Federal criminal trials result in conviction ~85% of the time
Announced government contract awards are finalized ~60% of the time without major changes
Announced trade negotiations result in signed deals ~35% of the time within stated timeframes
Threatened emergency declarations are issued ~55% of the time
Fed speeches move markets >1% only ~20% of the time; most are dovish/hawkish within expectations
Proposed fiscal stimulus packages pass Congress ~30% of the time in the form originally announced
Infrastructure proposals pass Congress ~40% of the time, usually with significant modifications
Proposals to create/abolish government agencies succeed ~10% of the time
NATO alliance commitments are honored ~90% of the time
UN Security Council resolutions on contentious issues pass ~35% of the time (veto threat)
